name: Ring Straddle Maltese Hold
steps: Take a straight-arm support on low rings with your hands beside your hips.
Lean forward and open your arms wide as you raise and spread your straight legs behind you.
Hold your body face down at ring height, with your shoulders and hips level.
Lower your feet to the floor under control before releasing the rings.
tips: Keep your knees fully locked and legs wide to shorten the lever compared to a full Maltese.
Maintain strict straight-arm tension and avoid letting your chest sink below the rings.
